response.text: {"name":"Dvajset metrov","idea":"The whole page is built on the one fact that makes this dairy what it is: the milk walks 20 metres from the barn to the kettle, so the page is a deep fir-green night over Lancovo with cheese-yellow light, measured in metres rather than in slogans.","palette":[{"role":"background","hex":"#16211a"},{"role":"surface","hex":"#1f2d24"},{"role":"text","hex":"#ede9dc"},{"role":"muted","hex":"#a9b3a5"},{"role":"primary","hex":"#e9c43f"},{"role":"onPrimary","hex":"#16211a"},{"role":"border","hex":"#34463a"},{"role":"band","hex":"#e9c43f"},{"role":"onBand","hex":"#16211a"}],"pairing":"fraunces-source-sans","typeCharacter":"Fraunces is soft, round and a little rustic, like letters pressed into a cheese rind; used heavy (weight 700 to 800) and large for the h1 at about 11vw and section headings at 5 to 6vw, always sentence case, tight line height, never italic. Source Sans 3 carries the running text at 18 to 20px in the pale text colour, lists and the hours table at 16 to 17px, all left aligned.","composition":"Section 1, hero, dark ground #16211a, 6 rows: the h1 'Sir iz hleva za vogalom' sits in columns 1 to 9 on two lines at about 11vw in cheese yellow #e9c43f; below it the lead in columns 1 to 6 in pale text; under the lead one single button in yellow with dark label 'Pokličite' and the phone beneath it as a 40px Fraunces numeral. Columns 9 to 12, rows 1 to 6, hold the layout system's line drawing: a large circle with one wedge cut out, stroked in yellow at 2px, bleeding slightly off the right edge, nothing else on it. Section 2, story, full-width yellow band #e9c43f, 4 rows: heading 'Od hleva do kotla je 20 metrov' in dark ink, Fraunces 800, columns 1 to 5 at about 6vw; columns 6 to 12 carry a simple line drawing, a horizontal rule with 20 short tick marks, a small barn outline (a box with a gabled roof) at the left end labelled 'hlev, 0 m' and a kettle outline (a half circle on a short stand) at the right end labelled 'kotel, 20 m', all strokes in dark ink 2px; under the rule the story text in columns 6 to 10. Section 3, a ribbon on dark ground, 1 row: a slow horizontal strip of the words 'sir · skuta · jogurt · sirotka · maslo · darilni paketi' in Fraunces 700 at about 4vw in muted green #a9b3a5, separated by yellow dots. Section 4, shop, dark surface #1f2d24, 5 rows: heading 'Iz naše trgovinice' columns 1 to 6; the offerings as a ruled list in columns 1 to 7 with 1px borders #34463a between rows: Poltrdi sir Lancovčan, Sir z bohinjskimi zelišči, Skuta, Jogurt, Sirotka, Maslo, Darilni paketi (note 'po naročilu' in muted); columns 9 to 12 a yellow-bordered box with 'Ogled sirarne s pokušino' and the two conditions: najmanj 8 oseb, najava vsaj tri dni prej. Section 5, hours, dark ground, 3 rows: heading 'Kdaj nas obiščete' columns 1 to 5; the opening hours as a week strip across columns 1 to 8, each day a column with a thin yellow top rule; columns 9 to 12 a short note that on Saturday mornings they are at the market in Radovljica. Section 6, contact, full-width yellow band, 4 rows: heading 'Pokličite za naročilo ali ogled' columns 1 to 6 in dark ink; the phone as a huge Fraunces numeral across columns 1 to 8 at about 8vw; email and the address 'Lancovo 41, 4240 Radovljica' in columns 1 to 4 beneath; columns 9 to 12 the simple schematic map in dark line on the yellow, Lancovo marked with a filled dot. On phones every section stacks in one column, the cheese-wheel circle sits above the headline, the 20-metre rule turns to run full width above its text.","imagery":"No photographs anywhere. All imagery is colour fields and the layout system's line drawings in 2px strokes: the cut cheese wheel (a circle with a missing wedge) in yellow on the dark hero ground, the 20-metre measuring rule with a barn outline and a kettle outline in dark ink on the yellow story band, and the schematic map in dark ink on the yellow contact band. The only ornament repeated is the small yellow dot between words in the product ribbon.","signature":"The 20-metre rule drawn across the yellow band, barn at one end and kettle at the other, every metre ticked: the shortest possible distance a milk can travel, turned into the page's one picture.","copy":{"headline":"Sir iz hleva za vogalom","lead":"Iz mleka naših 30 krav vsak dan izdelujemo sir. V trgovinici na kmetiji v Lancovem vas čakajo sir, skuta, jogurt, sirotka, maslo in darilni paketi."},"imagePrompt":"A deep fir-green screen filled by a huge cheese-yellow Fraunces headline on two lines in the left nine columns, lead text and a single yellow button beneath it, while a large yellow line-drawn circle with one wedge cut out bleeds off the right edge; no photographs, only type, colour and one stroked drawing."}
